title: Lume for Claude Chat: open decisions

items.question: Who runs the live Chat upload and workflow test?
options: A · Pedro runs CHAT-TEST-STEPS.md in his own Chat with synthetic content and posts the results on PR #62.
B · Pedro authorizes a separate session that signs in for him.
C · Skip the live test; Chat compatibility stays not proven.
items.recommended: A · Pedro runs CHAT-TEST-STEPS.md in his own Chat with synthetic content and posts the results on PR #62.

items.question: If loading a skill by name fails in Chat, what changes?
options: A · Make jef-director self-complete and keep 12 skills.
B · Merge into one skill (breaks 12-skill fidelity to the source).
C · Ship a separate Chat build and Code build.
items.recommended: A · Make jef-director self-complete and keep 12 skills.

items.question: Which version does the plugin carry?
options: A · 1.2.0 in both manifests; treat 1.1.5 in the old source README as stale.
B · 1.1.5, as in the source README.
items.recommended: A · 1.2.0 in both manifests; treat 1.1.5 in the old source README as stale.

items.question: Who is the LICENSE holder?
options: A · Pedro gives the exact holder text; the current text stays until then.
B · Keep Nercari as it stands now.
items.recommended: A · Pedro gives the exact holder text; the current text stays until then.

items.question: Three old commits still hold the personal name. What happens to them?
options: A · Leave history as it is and record the gap (no force-push).
B · Pedro approves a history rewrite and force-push, then the agent runs it.
items.recommended: A · Leave history as it is and record the gap (no force-push).
